title: POST /auth/login/confirm issues a tenant JWT with only email + tenant_id (no password / no proof of prior login)
evidence: TenantSelectionRequest has only Email and TenantID. LoginConfirm calls FindUserByEmailAllTenants, picks the user with matching TenantID and calls tokenService.GenerateToken. No password, no short-lived selection token. The route at main.go:444 is public (no middleware). The landing modal sends exactly {email, tenant_id}.
suspected_root_cause: Two-step multi-tenant login implemented without binding step 2 to step 1 (password verified only in Login, nothing carried forward).
recommended_fix: Have Login return a signed, short-lived, single-use selection token (bound to email + allowed tenant ids); require it in LoginConfirm; add rate limiting.
required_tests: Backend: LoginConfirm without valid selection token returns 401
Backend: selection token cannot be replayed or used for a tenant not in its list
Landing integration: multi-tenant login still completes end to end

title: Public order endpoints trust client-supplied X-Tenant-ID / X-Restaurant-ID and allow unauthenticated GET/DELETE by sequential order id
evidence: Public order routes are wrapped only in TenantContextMiddleware, which (when no JWT claims exist) falls back to X-Tenant-ID/X-Restaurant-ID headers. CancelOrder (DELETE /public/orders/{id}) cancels using tenantID/restaurantID from those headers and an integer id; no phone, token or order-number secret is required and no rate limit is applied to these routes (compare RateLimitByIP on the table route at main.go:466). GET /public/orders/{id}, /status, /track use the same wrapper. Response contents of GetOrder were not inspected.
suspected_root_cause: Public ordering reuses internal tenant middleware designed for 'backward compatibility' headers; ownership of an order is not proven by the caller.
recommended_fix: Resolve tenant from slug server-side for public routes; require an unguessable per-order token (or order number + phone) for read/cancel; rate-limit; use non-sequential public ids.
required_tests: Backend: DELETE /public/orders/{id} without ownership proof returns 401/403
Backend: cross-tenant header spoof cannot read another tenant order
Rate-limit test on public order routes

title: Newly registered tenants never get trial_start_date/trial_end_date, so access check never expires their trial
evidence: CreateTenantWithUser INSERT lists name, slug, domain, email, phone, subscription_plan, max_restaurants, max_users, is_active - no trial_* columns. Migration 110 gives subscription_status default 'trial' and trial_days default 15 but trial_start/end columns have no default. Migration 112 seeds dates only for rows existing at migration time. CheckTenantAccess blocks only when status=='trial' && trialEndDate.Valid && now>trialEnd, so NULL means unlimited access. GetExpiredTrials exists in the repo but grep found no caller (no expiry job). No trigger found in migrations (grep for trial_end_date outside 110-114).
suspected_root_cause: Registration path was not updated when the trial system (migrations 110-114) was added; no scheduled expiry.
recommended_fix: Set trial_start_date=NOW(), trial_end_date=NOW()+trial_days in the registration INSERT (single configurable constant); backfill NULL rows; add expiry job that flips status to expired.
required_tests: Register tenant then assert trial_end_date = start + configured days
Tenant with trial_end in past is blocked by TenantStatusMiddleware
Backfill migration test for NULL trial rows

title: Trial length inconsistent: 30 days (landing, README feature section) vs 15 days (DB defaults, migrations, README line 297, dashboard blocked screens)
evidence: Landing EN+AR copy says 30-day trial in 8+ places; DB default trial_days=15, seed uses '15 days'; README says both 'trial 15 days' (297) and '30 days' (415-418, 522, 529); dashboard hardcodes '15-day'.
suspected_root_cause: No single source of truth for trial length; copy is hardcoded in four places.
recommended_fix: Decide one value, expose via public config endpoint (e.g. /subscription/plans) and read it in landing + dashboard; fix README.
required_tests: Contract test: landing copy value equals backend default trial_days

title: Bearer JWT and full user object are passed in URL query strings across apps (landing->dashboard, super-admin->dashboard impersonation, dashboard-login)
evidence: Landing redirects to `${dashboardUrl}/auth/callback?token=<JWT>&user=<json>`; super-admin builds `/en/dashboard?impersonation_token=...`; backend returns redirect_url with ?token=. Tokens land in browser history, server/proxy access logs and Referer. The dashboard-login token is documented as 30 s one-time (store deletes on validate, super_admin_repo.go:673-674) but user JWTs are long-lived.
suspected_root_cause: Cross-origin handoff between landing and dashboard implemented via query string instead of POST/fragment/code exchange.
recommended_fix: Use a one-time auth code exchanged server-side, or URL fragment + immediate history.replaceState; add Referrer-Policy: no-referrer on callback pages; scrub from logs.
required_tests: E2E: callback page strips token from URL after consumption
Access-log check that tokens are not logged

title: RateLimitSuperAdmin uses an unsynchronized map and a new limiter instance per route
evidence: `clients := make(map[string]*clientInfo)` is read/written in the handler with no mutex (grep for Mutex/sync in file returns nothing). wrapSuperAdmin calls RateLimitSuperAdmin(30) each time a route is wrapped, so every route has its own map and its own 30/min budget; entries are never evicted.
suspected_root_cause: Placeholder limiter ('In production, use Redis').
recommended_fix: Create one limiter outside wrapSuperAdmin with sync.Mutex (or use existing RateLimitByIP implementation / Redis) and add eviction.
required_tests: go test -race with concurrent requests through wrapSuperAdmin
Limit is shared across routes

title: Backend Login logs prefix of submitted password and of stored bcrypt hash
evidence: fmt.Printf("Password hash from DB (first 30 chars)...") and fmt.Printf("Input password (first 3 chars): %s***"). Handler also prints email and password length. Also `PasswordHash[:30]` can panic on a short/empty hash.
suspected_root_cause: Debug prints left in production path.
recommended_fix: Remove; use structured logger with no credentials; guard slice.
required_tests: Log-capture test asserting no password/hash material in output

title: Forgot-password is not implemented end to end
source_files: backend/internal/usecase/auth_usecase.go (ForgotPassword, 'TODO: Generate reset token and send email')
evidence: Backend returns 'Password reset email sent' without generating a token or sending mail. Landing login links to /{locale}/auth/forgot-password which has no page (pages list). Stale test expects href '/auth/forgot-password'.
suspected_root_cause: UI link and API stub added ahead of implementation.
recommended_fix: Implement reset flow (token table, email, reset page) or hide link and return 501.
required_tests: Reset token lifecycle tests
Landing route exists test

title: Landing /login and /register shortcuts are broken by middleware (redirect to non-existent /en/login, /en/register); non-locale auth pages are dead code
evidence: Middleware prefixes any path lacking en|ar with /en, so /login -> /en/login; only [locale]/auth/{login,register,super-admin-login} exist, hence 404. /auth/login and /auth/register work, but only because the middleware redirects first; the page.tsx redirect stubs under app/auth, app/page.tsx never execute.
suspected_root_cause: Locale middleware added after the redirect stubs.
recommended_fix: Delete app/login, app/register, app/auth/*, app/page.tsx stubs; add explicit middleware rewrite for /login and /register if the shortcuts are wanted (backend super-admin redirect URLs and 401 interceptor use /auth/login).
required_tests: E2E: /login, /register, /auth/login resolve to localized pages

title: Landing marketing claims not backed by implementation or data
evidence: (a) 'Mobile Apps (iOS & Android)': no mobile project in repo (top-level search). (b) 'Unlimited Restaurants/Staff' while registration inserts max_restaurants=1, max_users=5; no enforcement code found by grep but values exist. (c) '500+ restaurants' and testimonial/'revenue +30%' copy are static strings. (d) Price 500 EGP matches DB seed (50000 cents) and env default, but landing hardcodes it instead of reading public /subscription/plans; backend also seeds an annual plan (500000 cents) not shown. (e) Footer links /demo /about /blog /help /docs /api /privacy /terms and #about #contact have no target. (f) 'No credit card' is consistent with trial flow.
suspected_root_cause: Marketing copy hardcoded and decoupled from product/billing.
recommended_fix: Remove or qualify unsupported claims; fetch plans from API; add or remove dead links; legal pages are required before launch.
required_tests: Link checker on landing
Copy/price contract test against /subscription/plans

title: Restaurant-website middleware treats 'localhost:3003' as a real subdomain, so bare localhost redirects to /maintenance
evidence: restaurantSlug = host.split('.')[0]; for 'localhost:3003' this is 'localhost:3003', which is !== 'localhost', so isRealSubdomain=true; backend GetTenantStatusBySlug returns 404 for unknown slug (subscription_handler.go:48-70) and the middleware redirects to /maintenance on 404. parseSubdomain (lib/subdomain.ts) strips the port correctly, so the two disagree. Runtime not executed (read-only audit).
suspected_root_cause: Duplicate, inconsistent subdomain parsing.
recommended_fix: Reuse parseSubdomain in middleware; validate slug with isValidRestaurantSlug; skip checks for IP/localhost.
required_tests: Unit: middleware host matrix (localhost:3003, slug.localhost:3003, slug.domain.com, www.domain.com, IP)

title: Tenant-status check in middleware fails open and is uncached (one backend call per request)
evidence: fetch to /public/tenant-status/{slug} on every matched request (matcher excludes only _next/static, _next/image, favicon, public); catch{} lets request through when API unreachable; non-200/non-404 responses (e.g. 500) also pass. lib/checkTenantStatus.ts has a 30 s cache and encodeURIComponent but grep finds no importer. Backend caches status 30 s (tenant_status.go:16) but the public by-slug handler does not use that cache.
suspected_root_cause: Helper written but middleware inlined its own version.
recommended_fix: Use the cached helper (or edge cache); decide fail-open vs fail-closed deliberately; encode slug.
required_tests: Middleware test with mocked fetch: blocked, 404, 500, timeout

title: Slug derived from Host header is unvalidated and interpolated unencoded into backend URLs; custom domains map to wrong slug
evidence: requestHeaders.set('x-restaurant-slug', restaurantSlug) correctly overwrites any client-sent header on locale routes (no header-injection pass-through), but the value is the raw first Host label, used unencoded in fetch paths. 'menu.example.com' or 'www' variants yield wrong slugs; menu page falls back to slug 'demo' when header is missing. Early-return paths (/maintenance, legacy table redirect) do not set the header.
suspected_root_cause: No slug validation / custom-domain lookup.
recommended_fix: Validate with isValidRestaurantSlug, encodeURIComponent, remove 'demo' fallback in production, add domain->slug lookup for custom domains.
required_tests: Unit: hostile Host values (../, %2f, long labels) rejected

title: Restaurant-website root <html> is always lang='en' dir='ltr' (locale param unavailable in root layout); landing sets dir only client-side
evidence: Root layout reads params.locale but sits above the [locale] segment so it is undefined -> 'en'/'ltr'. RTL is applied only on an inner <div dir>. Landing root has lang='en' and mutates document.documentElement in useEffect (flash of LTR, SSR/hydration mismatch). Super-admin is English only (lang='en').
suspected_root_cause: Locale segment nested below root layout.
recommended_fix: Move <html> into app/[locale]/layout.tsx (or use headers x-restaurant-locale) and set lang/dir server-side.
required_tests: SSR HTML for /ar contains <html lang=ar dir=rtl>
Visual RTL regression

title: Restaurant-website calls endpoints that are not registered in main.go
evidence: GET /public/orders (list, used by useOrders on /orders) - only POST /public/orders is registered. GET /public/themes/{slug} and /public/themes (theme-api, called from theme-store dynamic import) - not registered. API_ENDPOINTS constants (/orders/create, /orders/{id}, /themes, /products/search) match no route and appear unused.
suspected_root_cause: Frontend written against a planned API; dead constants kept.
recommended_fix: Remove My Orders list or implement it safely (phone/token scoped); point theme-api at /public/restaurants/{slug}/theme; delete dead constants.
required_tests: Contract test enumerating frontend endpoints vs mux patterns

title: Two API clients in restaurant-website; tenant/restaurant ids come from localStorage populated asynchronously
evidence: lib/api-client.ts (axios instance, adds auth-token + X-Tenant-ID/X-Restaurant-ID from localStorage) and lib/api/api-client.ts (plain axios wrapper, no headers) coexist. IDs are written after an async /info fetch in a useEffect, so early order calls can lack headers (backend then 400 'Missing tenant context'); stale IDs persist across slugs on the same browser origin (localhost). Cookies 'restaurant-slug'/'is-restaurant-site' are read but never set by middleware.
suspected_root_cause: Organic growth; tenant context passed client side.
recommended_fix: Single client; send slug (path/header) and resolve server-side; drop cookie fallback.
required_tests: Checkout test with cold localStorage
Slug switch test

title: Checkout hardcodes USD '$', client-side delivery fee (5.99, free over 50) and cash-only payment while product is priced in EGP
evidence: paymentMethod: z.literal('cash'); totals rendered with `$`; deliveryFee computed in browser. Order payload sends only product_id/quantity (prices computed server-side - good), so displayed total may differ from billed total.
suspected_root_cause: Prototype constants; no tenant currency/fee settings.
recommended_fix: Read currency and delivery fee from /settings or /info; get totals from /public/orders/validate.
required_tests: Checkout renders tenant currency
Displayed total equals server total

title: /maintenance renders tenant name and contact details from query string (anyone can craft a convincing page); mailto/tel built from params
evidence: name, email, phone come from searchParams; mailto:${contactEmail} and tel: links rendered. Page is served on any tenant subdomain without verifying a block actually exists.
suspected_root_cause: Contact info passed through redirect URL.
recommended_fix: Server-side lookup by slug in the page; ignore query params.
required_tests: Maintenance page ignores spoofed params

title: Unauthenticated POST /api/metrics stores arbitrary JSON in an in-memory buffer (entry count capped, size not)
evidence: metricsBuffer.push({...metric}) with no body-size or schema validation; GET/DELETE are dev-only, POST is not.
suspected_root_cause: Dev stub shipped.
recommended_fix: Validate schema/size, rate limit, or forward to analytics.
required_tests: Oversized payload rejected

title: Table QR menu resolves restaurant from global table id, overriding the host slug
evidence: GET /public/table/{id}/info takes only a numeric id (rate-limited 120/min/IP) and returns restaurant_slug; the page uses tableInfo.restaurant_slug over x-restaurant-slug, so a QR/URL for tenant B's table opened on tenant A's host renders B's menu while API headers (localStorage ids) may still be A's. Table ids are enumerable.
suspected_root_cause: Table lookup not scoped to the requesting tenant.
recommended_fix: Reject when table's slug != host slug; use opaque QR tokens.
required_tests: Mismatched table/host returns invalid table

title: Super-admin JWT kept in localStorage in two places; Logout never calls POST /super-admin/auth/logout
evidence: Token stored under 'super-admin-token' and inside persisted zustand store 'super-admin-auth-store'. Nav logout only removes both keys and sets location; api.logout() exists but is never invoked. Token is therefore not revoked server-side (whether Logout revokes was not verified).
suspected_root_cause: Client-only session handling.
recommended_fix: httpOnly secure cookie or in-memory token with short TTL + refresh; call backend logout; add CSP.
required_tests: Logout invalidates token server-side
XSS hardening headers test

title: Super-admin has no Next middleware; route guard is client-side only and dashboard shell can hang on 'Loading dashboard...'
evidence: No middleware.ts in the app. Provider restores only the token from 'super-admin-token'; dashboard layout renders a spinner whenever superAdmin is null even if a token exists (e.g. store cleared but token key present). API still enforces auth, so this is UX/defence-in-depth.
suspected_root_cause: SPA-style guard in an App Router app.
recommended_fix: Add middleware using an httpOnly cookie; refetch profile when token exists.
required_tests: Direct navigation to /dashboard without session redirects server-side

title: Super-admin links to /dashboard/users/{id} which has no page; ImpersonationBanner and validateImpersonationToken are unused
evidence: Only users/page.tsx exists under dashboard/users. api.validateImpersonationToken POSTs /super-admin/impersonate/validate, which would match the {userID} route (userID='validate') rather than the real public GET /api/v1/impersonation/validate; no caller. Banner imported nowhere.
suspected_root_cause: Incomplete feature wiring.
recommended_fix: Add users/[id] page or remove link; delete dead code or wire impersonation status.
required_tests: Link-check test for super-admin

title: Duplicate tenant disable/enable endpoints and implementations (PUT via SuperAdminHandler, POST via SubscriptionHandler); one-time dashboard-login tokens live in process memory
evidence: Frontend uses only POST variants. PUT variants remain registered. dashboardTokenStore is a package-level in-memory map: lost on restart and not shared across replicas (token TTL 30 s limits impact).
suspected_root_cause: Subscription phase added parallel handlers.
recommended_fix: Remove one pair; store tokens in Redis/DB if >1 replica.
required_tests: Multi-replica token exchange test

title: Super-admin IP whitelist is allow-all when empty and settings UI has no validation/lockout guard
evidence: IsIPAllowed returns true when IPWhitelist is empty. UI accepts any string, no CIDR/IP validation, no warning about locking out current IP. X-Forwarded-For is honored only from TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS (good).
suspected_root_cause: Convenience defaults.
recommended_fix: Validate on client and server; confirm current IP is included; require non-empty list in production.
required_tests: Invalid IP rejected
Self-lockout prevented

title: Workspace dependency declarations do not match usage
evidence: @pos-saas/ui is imported by dashboard (4 files) and restaurant-website (9) but declared by neither; resolved only via tsconfig paths. super-admin declares ui-components and ui-themes and transpiles them but imports neither. tsconfig paths and transpilePackages reference @pos-saas/types and @pos-saas/constants which do not exist under packages/. landing declares none yet lists @pos-saas/ui in transpilePackages and keeps local copies of button/input/label. ui-components exports only ./dist (no dist present) while dashboard imports ./registry through a tsconfig path to source. layers/shared-components (@pos/shared-components) is imported by no app; packages/theme is imported by no app.
suspected_root_cause: Packages evolved without dependency hygiene.
recommended_fix: Declare workspace deps where imported; remove unused ones and phantom paths; delete or archive unused packages.
required_tests: CI: depcheck / pnpm why validation; clean install build of each app

title: Three parallel section/component libraries (ui-components organisms, shared-components, ui-themes sections) for Hero/CTA/Testimonials/Contact
evidence: Each defines Hero, CTA, Testimonials, Contact(+Products/WhyUs). Only ui-themes is used at runtime (restaurant-website, dashboard); ui-components registry used by dashboard theme-builder; shared-components unused.
suspected_root_cause: Iterative redesign without removal.
recommended_fix: Pick ui-themes as canonical; migrate registry; remove others.
required_tests: Visual regression for theme sections after consolidation

title: UI packages contain network/analytics logic calling endpoints absent from main.go and using CRA env vars
evidence: useABTest -> /v1/admin/ab-tests/{id}/assign; useAssetUrl -> /v1/admin/assets/{id}; analyticsSDK -> /v1/events; base URL from process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL (not exposed by Next) defaulting to '/api'. grep of main.go finds none of these routes. grep finds no app importing these hooks.
suspected_root_cause: Speculative features in shared layer.
recommended_fix: Remove or move behind app-level adapters with real endpoints.
required_tests: Unused-export check

title: Thin automated test coverage for the three apps and mixed runners
evidence: Find of *.test.* excluding node_modules. turbo 'test' task exists but root package.json has no test script. Landing login test asserts a forgot-password href that does not match the localized route. Middleware, checkout totals, tenant actions, impersonation are untested.
suspected_root_cause: Tests added ad hoc.
recommended_fix: Add middleware, checkout, super-admin action and contract tests; wire into CI.
required_tests: As listed

title: Placeholder/localhost image hosts and doc drift in app configs
evidence: restaurant-website allows cdn.example.com and http://localhost images; landing uses deprecated images.domains with localhost; super-admin allows api.placeholder.com. Super-admin README lists NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL while code reads only NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPER_ADMIN_API_URL. Landing has a duplicate super-admin-login page while backend redirect_url targets the dashboard's page.
suspected_root_cause: Template leftovers.
recommended_fix: Make hosts env-driven; fix docs; remove duplicate page.
required_tests: Build with prod env

title: Subscription/disable enforcement is not applied to business API routes (TenantStatusMiddleware wired only to the self-skipping GET /tenant/status); access rules also duplicated
evidence: grep for TenantStatusMiddleware in main.go returns the definition at :612 (wrapProtectedWithStatus) and a comment; wrapProtectedWithStatus is used once, for GET /api/v1/tenant/status, a path the middleware itself skips (shouldSkipStatusCheck). All other protected routes use wrapProtected (Auth + TenantContext) or wrapWithPermission, so trial_expired / tenant_disabled / expired are enforced only by frontends (dashboard overlay, restaurant-website middleware redirect) and not by the API; a disabled or expired tenant can keep calling the API with a valid JWT (grep finds no is_disabled check in middleware, auth_usecase.go or auth_repo.go, so login also does not block disabled tenants). Additionally CheckTenantAccess ignores status=expired/suspended/cancelled while GetTenantSubscription blocks expired, so the two evaluators disagree. wrapWithPermission (main.go:621-628) is Auth + TenantContext + RequiredPermission only.
suspected_root_cause: Access rules duplicated in two places and not kept in sync.
recommended_fix: Apply a single AccessPolicy via TenantStatusMiddleware inside wrapProtected/wrapWithPermission (exempting /tenant/status, subscription/*, auth); reject login for disabled tenants; unify evaluators.
required_tests: Integration: disabled tenant JWT gets 403 on /api/v1/admin/* and POS routes
Integration: expired trial and expired paid tenants blocked, subscription/initiate still allowed
Table test: status x dates x disabled -> can_access identical across all evaluators
